attempts.kind: decoded integer precision defect found in review
attempts.failureSignature: JSON.parse('9007199254740993') yields 9007199254740992; a valid SQLite 64-bit integer could otherwise appear as a rounded decoded value.
attempts.hypothesis: Refusing unsafe integer fields before Python JSON emission, with a matching Node scalar guard, prevents false decoded-value citations without changing any GeoJSON behavior.
attempts.baseline: Bounded Node protocol-control reproduction confirms lossless=false and safeInteger=false; no original or record changed.
attempts.comparison: One Python parser-output fault control and one Node decoder-output fault control, both derived from the actual retained GeoPackage reader path. Unsupported integer fields must refuse PACKET_PLAN_NATIVE_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED.
attempts.successCriterion: Precision controls refuse; all real native records, packet/card/document tests, NYC comparisons and same-box verification still pass.
attempts.stopCondition: Any recurring rounding acceptance or GeoJSON byte change stops delivery.
